lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines identified; spacing is relatively uniform with highest contrast and thickness in the central torso, becoming narrower and more frequent toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (anterior) and lines 9-11 (posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before the mid-line of the torso mass compared to central segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are located on the lateral haunch, positioned horizontally relative to each other.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two posterior spots form a horizontal geometric alignment across the upper hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a sub-ocular spot and a cheek spot; distinct white throat patch and white horizontal band on the anterior forelimb.
